title: Database expand-migrate-contract: retire dependent consumers and work before contraction
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Sequence additive expansion, verified migration and contraction; reject old-structure removal while dependent old consumers or work remain.
preconditions: A modern browser opening local HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
Four fixed read-only synthetic labels; no concurrent writes or database.
Old readers require legacyLabel; two new bridge readers may fall back during expansion.
Zero to four old consumers and zero to three independent old work items.
No accounts, authentication, credentials, Azure subscription, server, framework or package changes.
actions: Choose faithful/corrupt-first migration, complete/partial/absent observations, old consumers and old work.
Start to lock assumptions, expand compatibly, and migrate four records.
Request contraction before and after independent consumer upgrades and old-work completion.
Inspect reader values, measured success/failure/unknown counts, dependency gates and user impact.
Inspect retained attempt traces, start another attempt, or explicitly reset all memory.
assertions: Expansion retains legacyLabel and both reader contracts while introducing nullable modernLabel.
Faithful migration preserves eight overlap reads; copied-row count alone proves no correctness.
Contraction requires ordered migration, completely observed correct values, no old consumers and no old work.
A corrupt observed value is a failed new-reader journey and retains interrupted impact.
Unobserved reads are unknown, never inferred from the configured fixture.
Only permitted contraction removes legacyLabel and verifies four surviving new-reader reads.
Strict inputs, immutable issued states, locked choices, event/attempt bounds and reset are enforced.

iac.decisionStage: After qualified loadable-stub assertion RED and before behavior implementation
iac.reason: Resource-free local synthetic lesson; no infrastructure or live migration is authorized.

testRuntime.lifecycle: openIsolatedLesson with awaited finally close; no abandoned prototype

limits: Synthetic fixed-data reads only; no real database, SQL, migration, lock, transaction or concurrent-write proof.
No native Azure behavior, source-parent completion, production Node.js 24 certification or availability claim.
A safe abort is not completed migration; missing observations cannot pass contraction.
History retains at most six attempts and twelve events each, in memory until explicit reset or reload.
B-S054 and D-S054 remain separate and unfulfilled.
One frozen S unit only; no extra test, evidence, tooling or refinement credit.
Only learning/S054 is owned; no root/shared, cloud, identity, deploy, spend, package or framework changes.
